about: The macOS versions the stick page offers and how Apple's recovery server is asked for them, for IntelXe Manager for Windows (Stick/Recovery.cs). The board IDs and the os type come from OpenCorePkg's Utilities/macrecovery (BSD-3-Clause): recovery_urls.txt names the board to ask with for each version (Tahoe with -os latest), boards.json the newest macOS each board gets. The logic board serial (sn) is that tool's default all-zero MLB, never a real one. 'status' is the driver's, from site/guide/hardware.html (macOS versions), tahoe.html and sequoia.html.

status.en: The driver's main platform: tested on 26.7.1.
Built from the same sources, not re-tested since the move to Tahoe: read the Sequoia page first.
